notes.title: HOROS release date
notes.notes:
I'm delighted to announce that we have the green light from STEAM, and we're almost ready to release the game.

Horos will be an epic adventure game mixed with a visual novel and spiced with simple RPG elements (optional). You'll be able to experience an immersive story with intriguing characters, enjoyable gameplay, and one-of-a-kind erotic sex scenes that blow you away.

Prepare yourself for the variety of cast. We’ve included not only typical fantasy RPG ladies that you can meet in a tavern or farm but also sexy elves ready to get dirty with a muscular hero, a noble hot wife, dark-skinned exotic candies, sex slaves and even a reanimated necromancer that is more than eager to suck your cock.

Have your sword ready because Horos is coming soon!

Remember that date – 2nd of June 2023!
